reason: Temporary exception for Zod 3.22.4 on six reviewed Vercel CLI development-tooling paths only. The audit validates version, development-only status and exact paths before excluding this finding; all application Zod 4 resolutions remain patched. Crafted build inputs can exhaust tooling memory.

Roy approved the temporary exception for the exact locked graph and locally patched Picomatch 2.3.2/4.0.7. The upstream PR 254 adaptation mitigates ordinary single-branch extglobs while preserving separator and escape compatibility. Related multi-branch patterns, complex escaped/separator branches and the explicit guard opt-out remain vulnerable. The audit verifies the lockfile and both patch hashes/configuration, and rejects changed versions, severity or unrelated advisories. Replace the mitigation with an official fix and remove this exception under ENG-686.
